portInfo.description: Piraeus is the cruise port for Athens. Ships use dedicated cruise terminals (commonly referenced as Terminal A / Miaoulis and additional berths). The Acropolis sits roughly 10–13 km away—plan metro, bus, taxi, or organized excursions rather than walking.
portInfo.location: Saronic Gulf, southwest of central Athens, Greece
portInfo.language: Greek; English widely used in tourism

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Note your berth (Terminal A vs further piers). Internal free shuttles often link outer berths to the main terminal area.
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Roughly 10–13 km to the Acropolis / central Athens
gettingThere.walkingTime: Metro stations are a meaningful walk from cruise gates (often ~20 minutes from the main terminal area, longer from outer berths)—many guests use taxi or an organized transfer when time is tight
gettingThere.taxiInfo: Taxis are the simplest timed option to the Acropolis; agree destination clearly
gettingThere.publicTransport: X80 Piraeus–Acropolis–Syntagma Express (seasonal): re-launched 23 May 2026; stops at both cruise-terminal exits; every 35–40 min, 07:00–21:15; ~35 min to central Athens. Separate fares from metro (secondary: €4.10 day ticket). Metro Line 3: from Piraeus / Dimotiko Theatro to Monastiraki ~22 min (secondary). Terminal A → metro ~20–25 min walk; B/C 35–45 min — taxi recommended. Airport: X96 bus from
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Roughly 10–13 km to the Acropolis / central Athens

thingsToDo.intro: Piraeus is Athens’ cruise gate. The Acropolis area is roughly 10–13 km away—plan metro, taxi, or an organized tour, not a walk from the pier.
topThings: Ancient Agora + National Archaeological Museum (city): after the standard Acropolis/Museum core, add Agora (≈75 min) and/or the National Museum (≈90 min) only if the remaining time still leaves a 75 min terminal buffer after the inbound X80/taxi. Publish a personal minimum before leaving the ship.

Cape Sounion: transfer time/distance not verified from a primary operator. Do not attempt as an independent cruise-day plan until a dated coach/train timetable and return buffer are confirmed; use a ship excursion or skip.
Overnight: Acropolis late afternoon, Plaka dinner (editorial).
Acropolis — 2 h; timed tickets; go early.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Midday Acropolis climbs in summer are demanding. Go early, carry water, and watch for heat-related site measures.
